name: Garage Guide
tagline: Builds a maintenance calendar for your car from its specs, mileage and service records
description: Enter the year, make, model and current mileage, plus whatever service records you have on hand, and it lays out the upkeep and repair work ahead as a calendar. Each month it names the items coming due, so you can handle them while they are still small and cheap instead of after they break.
author: Kirby21sk
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
